name: Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set
definition: For an order of the domain, let its order-shattered sets be those represented by cubes after downshifting in that order. The **Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set** is the minimum, over domain orders, of the largest cardinality of an order-shattered set.
graph_summary: The smallest, over coordinate orders, of the largest order-shattered dimension.
origin_references: Order shattering and its downshifting formulation are part of the shattering-extremal framework; see \cite{bollobas1995defect}.

monotonic.proof: For every fixed domain order, every order-shattered set of a subfamily remains order-shattered in a containing class.  Thus the largest such size cannot decrease for any order; taking the minimum over orders preserves the inequality.
